Demand forecasting for mid-market retail warehouses

Brightpath Analytics is a demand-forecasting platform that cuts stockouts for mid-market retailers running 5 to 50 warehouses. We ingest your point-of-sale and inventory feeds nightly and return per-SKU, per-warehouse replenishment quantities each morning.

See plans and pricing Book a 30-minute walkthrough

What Brightpath does

Brightpath produces a replenishment quantity for every SKU in every warehouse, every morning at 06:00 in your local time zone. Customers typically connect their first data feed in under three working days and see forecasts on day four.

How much it costs

Plans start at $480 per month for up to 5 warehouses and 20,000 active SKUs. The Growth plan is $1,450 per month for up to 20 warehouses. Full pricing, including the enterprise tier, is on the pricing page.

Who it is for

Brightpath is built for retail operations teams at companies with between $20M and $400M in annual revenue. It is not a fit for single-store retailers or for businesses without a digital inventory system, because the forecasts need at least 12 months of SKU-level history.

Where we are
